beats.say: Polygon says the new Ocarina of Time remake takes up 27 GB.
That makes this ground up remake larger than Tears of the Kingdom.
Polygon notes that Tears of the Kingdom takes up 24 GB on Switch 2.
IGN reports that the visuals in this remake have received a vast upgrade.
Polygon says the original Nintendo 64 game was released back in 1998.
The new remake will launch exclusively on Switch 2 on 5 November.
Will you be clearing space on your console for 5 November?
